title: Identification of key lipid metabolism-related genes in kidney fibrosis: implications for chronic kidney disease management.
authors: Cao, Qiuyu; Liu, Longhui; Zhou, Sai; Fei, Yang; Guo, Yi; Li, Yin; Sun, Shengyun; Yang, Aicheng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过机器学习识别肾纤维化脂代谢相关基因并构建诊断模型，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是基因表达与临床分型，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Kidney fibrosis (KF) represents a critical pathological alteration in the end stage of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and is the ultimate cause of mortality. Lipid metabolism plays a significant role in the pathogenesis of KF. Therefore, biomarkers associated with lipid metabolism will be identified to guide the treatment and management of CKD. METHODS: Three datasets obtained from the GEO database, along with 760 lipid metabolism-related genes sourced from two databases, were utilized to identify lipid metabolism-associated differentially expressed genes (LMDEGs) in KF. Subsequently, we performed GO, KEGG and ssGSEA enrichment analysis to elucidate the characteristics of LMDEGs. Then, machine learning was applied to identify core LMDEGs, Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) was utilized to construct a diagnostic model, and Receiver Operation Curve (ROC) was operated to evaluate the diagnostic performance. We used unsupervised hierarchical clustering to identify subtypes of KF associated with lipid metabolism and employed Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA) to examine differences among clusters. Finally, transcription factor and miRNA regulatory networks upstream of core LMDEGs were constructed using Cytoscape software. RESULTS: We identified 54 LMDEGs and constructed a six core LMDEGs (UGCG, SFRP1A6, OSBPL6, INPP5J, PNPLA3, and GK) predictive model by LASSO regression, achieving area under the curve (AUC) values ranging from 0.723 to 0.774. ssGSEA confirmed that these six core LMDEGs exhibited significant positive or negative correlations with immune cell infiltration. Based on the expression profiles of these core LMDEGs, KF samples were categorized into three distinct subtypes. One subtype is predominantly characterized by enhanced lipid and energy metabolism, another exhibits features of inflammation and immune response activation, while the third displays an intermediate pattern between the two extremes. Moreover, the regulatory network of these core LMDEGs shared several common transcription factors, suggesting a potential interplay between lipid metabolism and immune responses in the pathogenesis of KF. CONCLUSION: We have identified six core LMDEGs that are significantly associated with KF. Based on this, we have established three distinct clusters related to lipid metabolism in KF, which may provide valuable insights into the treatment and management of CKD.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾纤维化（KF）是慢性肾脏病（CKD）终末期的一种关键病理改变，也是导致死亡的根本原因。脂质代谢在KF的发病机制中发挥重要作用。因此，将识别与脂质代谢相关的生物标志物，以指导CKD的治疗和管理。方法：利用从GEO数据库获取的三个数据集，以及来自两个数据库的760个脂质代谢相关基因，鉴定KF中的脂质代谢相关差异表达基因（LMDEGs）。随后，我们进行了GO、KEGG和ssGSEA富集分析，以阐明LMDEGs的特征。然后，应用机器学习识别核心LMDEGs，使用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）构建诊断模型，并采用受试者工作特征曲线（ROC）评估诊断性能。我们使用无监督层次聚类识别与脂质代谢相关的KF亚型，并采用基因集变异分析（GSVA）检查聚类间的差异。最后，使用Cytoscape软件构建核心LMDEGs上游的转录因子和miRNA调控网络。结果：我们识别出54个LMDEGs，并通过LASSO回归构建了一个包含六个核心LMDEGs（UGCG、SFRP1A6、OSBPL6、INPP5J、PNPLA3和GK）的预测模型，其曲线下面积（AUC）值范围为0.723至0.774。ssGSEA证实这六个核心LMDEGs与免疫细胞浸润表现出显著的正相关或负相关。基于这些核心LMDEGs的表达谱，KF样本被分为三个不同的亚型。一个亚型主要以增强的脂质和能量代谢为特征，另一个表现出炎症和免疫反应激活的特征，而第三个则呈现介于两者之间的中间模式。此外，这些核心LMDEGs的调控网络共享多个共同的转录因子，提示脂质代谢与免疫反应在KF发病机制中可能存在相互作用。结论：我们识别出六个与KF显著相关的核心LMDEGs。基于此，我们建立了与脂质代谢相关的三个不同KF聚类，这可能为CKD的治疗和管理提供有价值的见解。
